features.quote: Hard Limit: Exactly 36 turns per episode.
Budget Cap: Max 200k output tokens per run. Hard stop if exceeded.
Stall Detection: If 3 consecutive turns contain zero tool calls and <20 non-whitespace characters, label STALL and abort.
Content Filter: Pipe every assistant output through a moderation endpoint… If self-harm or violence flags trigger, abort the run and exclude it from analysis.
features.justification_quote: abort the run and exclude it from analysis

features.quote: If the model alternates between the exact same two tool calls >4 times, auto-inject: "You appear to be stuck in a loop. Consider a fundamentally different hypothesis."

Maintain a hash of the last 3 (tool_name, arguments) tuples. If the model emits an exact duplicate… append to the next observation: [System Note] You just repeated an action that produced the same result. Consider a novel approach rather than re-trying the same step.
